text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold Stock B as it rose, locking in gains; next time I’ll judge its outlook and role in my portfolio rather than sell simply because I’m pleased with a gain.","I sold Stocks D and E at steep losses, which was painful. I’ll reassess holdings on their merits and avoid letting either loss aversion or the urge to stop the pain dictate my decision.","My account value fluctuated despite trading, and it rose while I held in periods 8 and 9. I’ll use a clear, diversified plan and avoid treating frequent trades or short-term moves as a reliable way to improve results."]}
